title: Two clean checkouts of one commit gave different content revisions (Engram's main checkout and a linked worktree at b5db805)
outcome: The cause of the difference is named from a per-path comparison of the two trees, and either the content revision is made to agree for two trees that Git reports as identical and clean, or src/content_revision.rs says precisely which differences Git does not show move it, with a test for each.
acceptance: A note names, from a per-path comparison of the two listings the revision hashes (path, mode, normalized content hash), which paths differed between the two trees and why.

If the cause is in the revision (line endings, mode, listing, path spelling), a test reproduces it and the fix makes two clean checkouts of one commit hash alike; if the trees really differed in content Git status does not show, the file's header comment states that case and a test pins it.
The full five-stage gate passes on the exact reviewed tree, its run directory and diff hash cited in a note.
